components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — pastry pink with cocoa text, 44px min height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-pink, #FED4D9); color: var(--color-cocoa, #4A3728); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(74, 55, 40, 0.08); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-pink-dark, #F5B8C0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lavender fill for secondary emphasis and active filter actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); color: #fff; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-lavender-dark, #937598); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E8E4DC); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-cocoa, #4A3728); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-pink-light, #FFF0F2); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default input — white fill, linen border, lavender focus, 44px height.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #E8E4DC); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-cocoa, #4A3728); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #7A6B5C); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White content island on the gingham field.
components.html:
Sunday Sauce

Family classic with slow-simmered tomatoes.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card, #fff); color: var(--color-cocoa, #4A3728); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74, 55, 40, 0.05); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74, 55, 40, 0.05); outline: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E8E4DC); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #7A6B5C); }

components.name: Filter Badge
components.description: Pill filter/meta chip; lavender when active.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-pink-light, #FFF0F2); color: var(--color-cocoa, #4A3728); font: 500 0.75rem/1 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-active { background: var(--color-lavender, #AF93B3); color: #fff; }

components.name: App Header
components.description: Fixed pastry-pink header with wordmark; pads safe-area-inset-top.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) 1rem 0; background: var(--color-pink, #FED4D9); color: var(--color-cocoa, #4A3728); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74, 55, 40, 0.05); font: 700 1.125rem/1 Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Family Recipes looks and feels like a warm kitchen table covered in a butter-gingham cloth — inviting, rounded, and soft-spoken. Soft pink leads brand and chrome; lavender marks selection and progress; yellow accents warmth without shouting. Cocoa brown carries all reading text. Density stays comfortable for thumbs with generous page padding, soft cocoa-tinted shadows, and pill-friendly radii.
keyCharacteristics: Gingham tablecloth page field with white card surfaces
Soft pink header chrome and primary CTAs
Nunito everywhere — rounded, friendly, never clinical
Cocoa-tinted shadows and borders (never cold gray UI chrome)
iPhone-first layout with safe areas and 44px touch targets
Three-layer surface stack: page → card → nested inset

rules.name: The One Accent Voice Rule
rules.body: On any given screen, pink owns primary action; lavender owns selection state; yellow is garnish. Do not invent a fourth accent for variety.

rules.name: The No Cold Gray Rule
rules.body: Prefer cocoa/mushroom/linen tokens over Tailwind gray-* or blue SaaS links in product UI.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce Inter, Roboto, or a second display face. Nunito is the product voice.

rules.name: The Thumb-First Rule
rules.body: Primary actions and list interactions must work in a one-handed iPhone portrait grip.

rules.name: The Safe Stage Rule
rules.body: Every fixed top/bottom surface pads Apple safe-area insets.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Prefer ring-1 ring-border + shadow-sm over heavy multi-layer drop shadows or glow.

rules.name: The Soft Corner Rule
rules.body: Sharp 0-radius UI and hairline broadsheet layouts are out of character.

rules.name: The Content-Width Action Rule
rules.body: Buttons size to their label by default. Full-bleed is reserved for primary submits in narrow stacks. Never stretch destructive or secondary actions across a wide settings/list card.

dos: Do compose new screens from src/components/ui primitives and @theme tokens in globals.css.
Do keep 44×44 minimum touch targets for tappable controls.
Do pad fixed chrome with env(safe-area-inset-*) on iPhone.
Do use the page → card → nested surface hierarchy.
Do use Herb Success tokens for positive completion states.
donts: Don't introduce purple-on-white SaaS gradients, Inter/Roboto defaults, or dark-mode-first skins.
Don't use Tailwind gray-* or default green-* when semantic tokens exist.
Don't nest cards inside cards for decoration.
Don't ship hover-only affordances as the only way to act.
Don't place controls under the iOS home indicator or status bar.
Don't stretch destructive or secondary actions to the full width of a wide card.
Don't treat scalloped/lace ornaments as required — they are optional future garnish, not the system.
